key_insight: Hierarchical QEC decoding can coordinate stages within a single code or across code levels, with distinct throughput, latency, and integration trade-offs.
engineering_relevance: Practical fault-tolerant systems need decoders matched to qubit timing requirements and hardware platforms to turn syndrome streams into timely correction information.
method: Review cascaded, windowed, streaming, and distributed decoding.
Compare cross-level information sharing and CPU, GPU, FPGA, ASIC, and cryogenic implementations.
evidence_signal: The abstract describes a literature-based assessment under reported evaluation conditions, without presenting quantitative benchmarks or a new experimental validation.
watch_item: Gaps in performance reporting and system integration limit direct comparisons and confidence in end-to-end deployment readiness.
paper_title: Hierarchical Decoding for Quantum Error Correction
